title: NewPlayerProtection
description: A powerful and fully configurable Minecraft plugin that protects new players from PvP, mobs, and damage, ensuring a fair and smooth start on any SMP server.
body:
🛡 NewPlayerProtection

A smart, modern protection system designed for new players on SMP servers.
Give players a safe start without breaking balance ⚡

--- ## ✨ Why Choose NewPlayerProtection? ✔ Prevents unfair spawn kills ✔ Fully configurable protection system ✔ Supports PvP, mobs, crystals, and environment ✔ Beautiful BossBar & ActionBar UI ✔ Clean GUI-based protection removal ✔ Designed for performance (no lag) --- ## ⚙️ Core Features ### 🛡 Smart Protection System * Automatically protects new players on join * Blocks PvP and mob damage (configurable) * Prevents crystal and explosion abuse * Protection removes automatically on attack --- ### 🎮 Gameplay Control * Control PvP interactions * Manage mob behavior * Configure damage types (lava, fall, void, etc.) * Inventory interaction control --- ### 🎨 Premium Experience * Gradient MiniMessage messages 🌈 * BossBar + ActionBar timer display * Clean and modern GUI * Sound & visual feedback --- ### 🛠 Admin Friendly * Powerful command system * Fully documented config * Reload support * Easy customization --- ## 🚀 Perfect For ✔ SMP Servers ✔ Survival Servers ✔ Public Communities ✔ New Player Friendly Networks --- ## 📦 Compatibility * ✅ Minecraft **1.20+** * ✅ Paper / Spigot * ✅ Lightweight & optimized ---

--- ## ❤️ Credits Developed by **Flaxa Technologies** --- ## 🔥 Final Note Make your server more welcoming, fair, and professional — without sacrificing gameplay balance.
